pages.title: Roblox Boy with Spiky Hair Wearing a T-shirt and Jeans in a City Plaza Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a spiky-haired Roblox boy wearing a T-shirt and jeans in a city plaza, with a fountain behind him. His smiling face, chunky sneakers, and hand resting at his pocket fill the foreground. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing areas with smaller tree, window, and paving details.

pages.title: Roblox Bacon Hair Boy Wearing a Motorcycle Jacket and Jeans on a Spawn Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Bacon Hair boy stands on a star-marked spawn platform in this printable coloring page, wearing a motorcycle jacket over a plain shirt. Ribbed shoulder panels, diagonal lapels, and multiple zippers distinguish his outfit. Block-shaped trees and raised stepping platforms surround him on a coloring sheet with large clothing panels and fine fastener details.

pages.title: Roblox Emo Boy with Side Swept Hair Wearing Striped Sleeves and a Chain Belt on City Steps Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox emo boy on city steps, with side-swept hair, striped sleeves, and a chain belt over cargo pants. A star-shaped pendant hangs above his shirt, while loops of chain drape beside a pocket. The coloring sheet contrasts broad stair treads with small links, hair sections, and sleeve stripes.

pages.title: Roblox Boy Wearing a Puffer Jacket and a Crossbody Bag Beside a Graffiti Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox boy wears a puffer jacket and crossbody bag beside a graffiti wall in this printable coloring page, with cargo pants and lace-up sneakers. Wide padded jacket sections frame the small zippered bag and its adjustable strap. Angular graffiti shapes and brick outlines add background sections to this streetwear coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Boy Wearing a Suit and Sunglasses Beside a Sports Car Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents a Roblox boy in a suit and sunglasses beside a sports car, with spiky hair and a neatly knotted tie. His single-button jacket has outlined lapels and pocket flaps, while the car sits just behind him. The coloring sheet leaves generous suit panels around the smaller wheel spokes and angular headlights.

pages.title: Roblox Skater Boy Wearing a Hoodie and Riding a Skateboard at a Skatepark Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox skater boy rides a skateboard through a skatepark in this printable coloring page, balancing with outstretched arms in a hoodie and cargo pants. His bent knees, large sneakers, and tilted board give the pose a diagonal shape. Curved ramps and railings frame a coloring sheet with open clothing areas and smaller wheels and drawstrings.

pages.title: Roblox Boy Doing a Dab Beside a Pair of Speakers in a Plaza Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures a Roblox boy doing a dab between two speakers in a plaza, wearing a hoodie and winking as he poses. One arm angles upward while the other crosses his face. Circular speaker cones, a raised round platform, and blocky trees create distinct shapes around the figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Snowboarder Boy Wearing Goggles and Riding Down a Snowy Slope Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox snowboarder boy rides down a snowy slope in this printable coloring page, with goggles resting above his eyes and boots strapped onto his board. Snow sprays around the board beneath his bent knees and spread arms. The coloring sheet includes broad jacket panels, binding details, distant mountain peaks, and snow-covered fir trees.

pages.title: Roblox Construction Worker Boy Wearing a Hard Hat and Holding a Hammer at a Building Site Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox construction worker boy holding a claw hammer at a building site, wearing a hard hat and striped safety vest. Stacked bricks and tall scaffolding surround his sturdy boots and cargo trousers. The coloring sheet offers large vest and helmet areas alongside narrow framework bars and small brick shapes.

pages.title: Roblox Firefighter Boy Holding a Fire Hose Beside a Fire Truck Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox firefighter boy holds a fire hose beside a ladder truck in this printable coloring page, wearing a helmet with a badge and striped protective gear. Both hands support the nozzle, and the hose curves back toward the vehicle. Truck compartments, ladder rungs, and broad boot shapes add varied sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Pilot Boy Wearing an Aviator Uniform Beside an Airplane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox pilot boy in an aviator uniform beside a passenger airplane, with a peaked cap, tie, and wing badges. Shoulder bars and cuff stripes add repeated details to his jacket. The coloring sheet places the plane’s windows and landing gear behind the figure, with a small control tower farther back.

pages.title: Roblox Knight Boy Holding a Sword and Shield Outside a Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox knight boy holds an upright sword and a large shield outside a castle gate in this printable coloring page, wearing layered plate armor. Diamond emblems repeat on his chest, sword guard, and shield, while two flag-topped towers rise behind him. The coloring sheet mixes broad armor plates with stonework, gate bars, and cobblestone outlines.

pages.title: Roblox Ninja Boy Wearing a Face Mask and Holding a Sword in a Bamboo Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Roblox ninja boy holding a sword in a bamboo grove, with a face mask and a knotted waist sash. His sword angles across a tunic with a crossed neckline, while bands wrap around his forearms. Tall segmented stalks, pointed leaves, and scattered rocks surround the figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Wizard Boy Wearing a Pointed Hat and Holding a Staff Inside a Wizard Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox wizard boy holds a crystal-topped staff inside a wizard tower in this printable coloring page, wearing a pointed hat decorated with stars and a crescent moon. Star motifs continue down his robe beside a round cloak clasp. The coloring sheet includes an arched window, bookshelves, a candle, and an orb on a table.

pages.title: Roblox Samurai Boy Wearing Layered Armor and Holding a Katana Outside a Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox samurai boy holding a katana outside a temple, with overlapping armor plates, tied cords, and a waist sash. His lowered blade stretches across the foreground below shoulder guards and tassels. Temple steps, a tall banner, and a garden lantern add smaller architectural details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Superhero Boy Wearing a Cape and Standing on a City Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox superhero boy stands on a city rooftop in this printable coloring page, wearing a flowing cape and a suit with a geometric chest emblem. Round clasps hold the cape at his shoulders above a circular belt buckle. The coloring sheet provides broad costume panels, simple cloud shapes, and narrow building windows around the figure.

pages.title: Roblox Boy Holding a Paint Roller and Painting the Wall of a House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Roblox boy painting a house wall with a raised paint roller, standing beside a bucket with drips around its rim. His open hoodie and cargo pants contrast with the horizontal siding behind him. A window, stepladder, and garden fence add clear background sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Roblox Miner Boy Wearing a Mining Helmet and Holding a Pickaxe in a Crystal Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox miner boy holds a pickaxe in a crystal cave in this printable coloring page, wearing a mining helmet with a headlamp and buckled suspenders. Faceted crystal clusters rise around his boots and along the rocky walls. This coloring sheet combines large shirt and trouser sections with angular gem faces, overhead rock points, and small belt details.

pages.title: Roblox Boy Wearing a Fishing Vest and Fishing Beside a Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Roblox boy fishing beside a pond, wearing a pocketed fishing vest and holding a rod with both hands. A float rests among circular ripples near two lily pads. The coloring sheet includes small reel and vest details, with larger open areas across the water, rocks, and clothing.

pages.title: Roblox Halloween Boy Wearing a Vampire Costume and Carrying a Pumpkin Bucket Outside a House Coloring Page
pages.description: A Roblox Halloween boy carries a pumpkin bucket outside a house in this printable coloring page, wearing a vampire costume with a high-collared cape. A ruffled shirt front, buttoned vest, and round neck clasp distinguish his outfit. The coloring sheet adds a jack-o’-lantern on the steps, a porch light, and a large round moon.
